ResStock Measure Documentation: Advanced Air Sealing With Drill-and-Fill Wall Insulation

item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, the Advanced Air Sealing upgrade:

- **Applies to:** Homes with baseline infiltration rates of **6 ACH50 or greater**; homes below that threshold are excluded.
- **Seals them to:** **5 ACH50**, meaning five air changes per hour at a test pressure of 50 pascals.
- **Covers:** Approximately **92% of existing dwelling units** in the modeled housing stock.

Sources: [Release 1 package definitions](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf) and [measure documentation, pp. 1 and 5–6](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96281.pdf).
